summaries.en: fanqiang is a curated collection of tools and resources for bypassing internet censorship, primarily targeting users in China. summary_short.zh: Mattermost 是一个开源协作平台，专为软件开发生命周期中的安全沟通设计，替代Slack等专有工具。它提供消息传递、文件共享及DevOps工具集成，技术核心基于Go和React构建，采用单体仓库结构，通过插件系统实现高扩展性。核心优势包括数据主权、合规性（如HIPAA）和离线能力，适合数据安全要求严格的组织。用户可搭建私有聊天服务器，集成GitLab或Jira，或通过插件和API自定义工作流，是企业团队控制通信数据的可靠选择。

summaries.en: Mattermost is an open-source platform for secure, self-hosted collaboration across the software development lifecycle. It replaces proprietary tools like Slack, offering messaging, file sharing, and integrations with DevOps tools. Technically, it's built with Go and React, featuring a monorepo structure and a plugin system for extensibility. Its strengths include data sovereignty, compliance (e.g., HIPAA), and offline capabilities. Use it to set up a private chat for your team, integrate with GitLab or Jira, or customize workflows via plugins and APIs. Ideal for enterprises needing control over communication data.

summaries.en: Restic is a fast, secure, and efficient backup tool that solves the problem of reliable data protection across platforms. It uses content-defined chunking and deduplication to minimize storage, and encrypts data with AES-256 by default. Its key technical insight is a lock-free repository design that enables concurrent backups without conflicts. You can use it to back up local files to cloud storage (S3, Backblaze B2) or self-hosted servers, with simple commands like 'restic backup' and 'restic restore'.

summary_short.zh: Chatwoot 是一个开源的全渠道客户沟通平台，旨在替代 Intercom、Zendesk 等商业工具。它通过统一的仪表盘整合实时聊天、邮件和社交媒体消息，让客服团队在一个界面中处理所有对话。技术上，Chatwoot 利用 ActionCable 实现实时消息推送，并支持多通道收件箱管理。你可以通过 Docker 自托管或一键部署到 Heroku，还能自定义聊天插件样式，并与 CRM、分析工具集成。对于注重数据隐私或希望完全掌控客户沟通流程的初创团队，这是一个理想的解决方案。

summaries.en: SkillSpector is a security scanner for AI agent skills, designed to detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and security risks in skill code. It uses static analysis and pattern matching to identify common security issues like command injection, data leakage, and unsafe deserialization. You can integrate it into your CI/CD pipeline to automatically scan skills before deployment, or use it as a standalone tool to audit existing skill repositories.

summary_short.zh: AgentsView 是一款面向编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex 等 20 多种）的本地优先会话智能与分析工具，旨在解决代理行为不透明的问题。它能捕获并可视化代理的交互过程，提供行为与性能洞察，且所有数据保留在本地，无需上传云端。技术上采用轻量级 Go 后端实现高速处理，号称比 ccusage 快 100 倍。你可以本地运行它来调试代理工作流、比较不同代理的策略，或优化提示词——非常适合开发或评估 AI 编码助手的开发者。

summaries.en: AgentsView is a local-first analytics tool for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex, solving the problem of opaque agent sessions. It captures and visualizes agent interactions, offering insights into behavior and performance without sending data to the cloud. Technically, it uses a lightweight Go backend for fast processing, claiming 100x speed over alternatives like ccusage. You can run it locally to debug agent workflows, compare agent strategies, or optimize prompts—ideal for developers building or evaluating AI coding assistants.

summary_short.zh: SIA是一个自我改进的AI框架，能自动提升任意AI系统（模型或智能体）在基准任务上的性能。其核心是将AI系统视为黑盒，通过迭代生成候选改进方案并测试，借助反馈循环实现无需人工干预的优化。技术上采用进化搜索或无梯度优化，避免传统微调对模型内部结构的依赖。用户只需提供评估函数，SIA即可自主探索改进方向，适用于分类、强化学习或LLM智能体等任务，特别适合希望快速迭代AI系统的开发者。

summaries.en: SIA is a self-improving AI framework that autonomously boosts the performance of any AI system (model or agent) on benchmark tasks. It works by iteratively generating and testing candidate improvements, using a feedback loop to refine the system without human intervention. Technically, it treats the AI system as a black box and applies evolutionary search or gradient-free optimization. You can use SIA to automatically enhance your existing models or agents, saving time on manual tuning. Try it on classification, reinforcement learning, or LLM agents to see performance gains.
